Case ID: 1182
Case Type: Shipping Claim
Date: 2025-04-07
Handled By: Claims - Mei Tan
Customer or Requestor: Oliver Grant
Title: International parcel delayed in customs with perishable item

Issue Description
An international order containing a time-sensitive product was held in customs beyond the acceptable delivery window, creating likely spoilage risk and customer dissatisfaction.

Steps Taken
- Verified export paperwork and confirmed the shipment was handed to the carrier with complete customs data.
- Reviewed carrier and broker updates to determine whether release was likely within a reasonable timeframe.
- Checked policy coverage for perishable or time-sensitive international shipments delayed outside customer control.
- Coordinated with Customer Support and Finance on whether to replace, refund, or await customs release.

Resolution
Approved a refund because the item was no longer likely to arrive in usable condition and documented the loss as a customs-delay claim for recovery review.

Follow-Up
International Operations reviewed whether the product should remain eligible for that destination lane.

Reference Documents
- Lost Shipment Runbook v3
- Shipping Exception Runbook v2
